description: This file contains the source code for managing the creation, editing, deletion, copying, moving, and display of test suites and test cases within the TestLink testing management system. It includes functions to handle user actions, update the database, build user interfaces with Smarty templates, and interact with various managers related to test projects, test suites, and test cases.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Manager class for handling hierarchical structures of test projects and test suites.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Manager class for handling test project operations.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: Manager class for handling test suite operations.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Manager class for handling individual test case operations.
